title: Reports of aircraft that went missing after chasing objects

tellings.quote: there's there's a gentleman that sends me on several times a month stories that he's pulled up about aircraft that have mysteriously gone missing.

plain: Aircraft are said to have vanished after chasing unknown objects in the sky. The former Navy fighter pilot Ryan Graves tells Michels that a man sends him such stories "several times a month", ones he has dug up about "aircraft that have mysteriously gone missing", though Graves does not name any of the cases.
